body:
You can use `transformData.item` to change the URL to one relative to the correct page. See [the docs](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hierarchicalMenu.html#struct-HierarchicalMenuTransforms) for that.

Basically it's a function which will give you an `item` object (including `url`), and you should return a new `item` object, but you can change everything on it, like the `url` here.
